description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline's setPosition functionality, specifically testing the behavior of the media pipeline when setting position in various playback and network states. It defines a test fixture class 'RialtoClientMediaPipelineSetPositionTest' with setup and teardown methods, and includes tests for valid and invalid states, verifying that position setting requests are correctly sent over IPC and that pending data requests are cleared appropriately.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineSetPositionTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the setPosition behavior of the media pipeline, including setup, teardown, and specific test cases for different playback and network states.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates the media pipeline, and sets the default playback state to playing.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment by destroying the media pipeline.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the media pipeline, mocking the IPC call.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sends a setPosition request over IPC and verifies success.

methods.description: Tests that needData requests are removed after setting position in a given playback state.
